entities.text: Karun Vs. State of M.P. ) Indore Dated
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Shri Anil Ojha, learned Public Prosecutor for the non- applicant -State.

This criminal revision is filed against the judgment dated 21.08.2019 passed in Cr.A.No.05/2017 by Ist Additional Sessions Judge, Dhar affirming the judgment pronounced by the learned Judicial Magistrate First Class, Dhar in criminal case no.2383/2010 on 23.12.2016 convicting the applicant for offence under Sections 7(1),16(1)(A-1) of Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954 and sentenced to 6 months S.I.with fine of Rs.3,000/- with default stipulation.
Revision is admitted for final hearing.
Learned counsel for the applicant made submissions on I.A.No.7082/2019 which is an application for suspension of sentence and grant of bail.
The length of the argument is that the case under Section 16(1) of Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954 was tried by Judicial Magistrate First Class, where as he was not empowered.

He has pointed out the notification No.3369-XVII-Med.-IV dated 11.10.1977 which is reproduced as under:-
"In exercise of the powers conferred by Section 16A of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954 (No.27 of 1954), the State Government hereby empowers:-
(1) Chief Judicial Magistrates at headquarters of all revenue districts in the State;
(2) Additional Chief Judicial Magistrates at headquarters of all revenue districts in the State; and (3) Senior most presiding officers of Courts of Judicial Magistrates of First Class at Headquarters of all Tahsils in the State; not being also headquarters of revenue districts; to try all offences under sub-section(1) of Section 16 of the said Act in summary way.

entities.text: Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954 (No.27 of 1954)
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: (2) The First Class Magistrate, who is senior in Service, may be treated as the senior most Magistrate, First Class in a Tahsil Headquarter."

Learned counsel submits that the case was tried by Judicial Magistrate First Class headquarter at Dhar and as per notification was not empowered to try the offence under Section 16(1) of Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954 .

He has placed reliance on the judgment in the cases of Karun vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 9 September, 2019 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/170216655/

sentences.text: Premnarayan Rathi Vs. State of M.P.1195 (II) MPWN 112, Chintulal Vs. Asharam 1992 (II) MPWN 116, Muneem Vs. State of M.P., 1994 (II) MPWN 103, Sonelal Vs. State of M.P. 1972 JLJ 1031 in which it has been held that the Judicial Magistrate First Class was not empowered to try offences under Section 16(1) of Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954 as per the notification.

entities.text: Premnarayan Rathi Vs. State of M.P.1195 (II) MPWN 112
entities.label: PRECEDENT

entities.text: Muneem Vs. State of M.P., 1994 (II) MPWN 103
entities.label: PRECEDENT

entities.text: Sonelal Vs. State of M.P. 1972 JLJ 1031
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The notification and the citations cited above were perused.

These apart Section 461 of Cr.P.C. is also relevant in which it has been stated that if any Magistrate, not being empowered by law in this behalf, does any of the following things namely .................. or (l) tries an offender.........his proceedings shall be void.
Thus, it appears that the proceedings carried out by the Judicial Magistrate First Class is such irregularity which vitiates the proceedings.
Counsel for State has opposed the application.

Considering the submissions made by the learned counsel for the parties, I.A.No.7082/2019 for suspension of sentence is allowed and it is directed that on deposit of fine amount, if not already deposited and on furnishing bail bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- with one surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court for his appearance before the Registry of this Court on 15.10.2019 and on subsequent dates as may be fixed by the Registry, the applicant-Karun be released on bail and the substantive sentence shall remain suspended pending this revision.
IA No.7082/2019 stands disposed of.
Certified copy as per rules.

(Shailendra Shukla) Judge RJ Karun vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 9 September, 2019 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/170216655/
